import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem algebra_amgm_sum1toneqn_prod1tonleq1
  (a : ℕ → NNReal)
  (n : ℕ)
  (h₀ : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x = n) :
  ∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x ≤ 1 := by
  -- Handle the case when n = 0 separately since division by zero is undefined
  -- When n = 0, the sum is 0 and the product is 1 (empty product), so 1 ≤ 1 holds
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    simp [Finset.sum_range_zero, Finset.prod_range_zero] at h₀ ⊢
    norm_num
  | succ n =>
    -- For n > 0, apply the AM-GM inequality
    -- The arithmetic mean is (∑ a x) / n = n / n = 1
    -- By AM-GM, the geometric mean ≤ arithmetic mean = 1
    -- Therefore the product ≤ 1^n = 1
    have h₁ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x) ^ (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ (∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x) / (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
      -- Apply the AM-GM inequality for non-negative reals
      exact NNReal.geom_mean_le_arith_mean (fun i _ => a i) (by simp [Nat.cast_pos, Nat.succ_pos])
    -- Convert the sum condition to the required form
    have h₂ : (∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x : ℝ) = (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
      norm_cast at h₀ ⊢
      <;> simp_all [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    -- Substitute into the AM-GM inequality
    rw [h₂] at h₁
    -- Simplify the right side: (n+1)/(n+1) = 1
    have h₃ : ((∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x : ℝ) / (n + 1 : ℝ)) = 1 := by
      field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)]
    rw [h₃] at h₁
    -- Raise both sides to power (n+1) to get the product bound
    have h₄ : ∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x ≤ 1 := by
      calc
        ∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x = (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x : ℝ) ^ 1 := by simp
        _ ≤ 1 ^ (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
          -- Use the fact that if x^(1/k) ≤ 1, then x ≤ 1^k = 1
          have h₅ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x : ℝ) ≥ 0 := by positivity
          have h₆ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x : ℝ) ^ (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := h₁
          have h₇ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
            -- Since the k-th root is ≤ 1 and the base is non-negative, the base itself is ≤ 1
            have h₈ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x : ℝ) ≥ 0 := by positivity
            have h₉ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x : ℝ) ^ (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := h₁
            have h₁₀ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
              by_contra h
              have h₁₁ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x : ℝ) > 1 := by linarith
              have h₁₂ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a x : ℝ) ^ (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) > 1 := by
                -- If base > 1, then any positive power is > 1
                have h₁₃ : (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) > 0 := by positivity
                exact Real.one_lt_rpow (by linarith) (by positivity)
              linarith
            exact h₁₀
          exact h₇
        _ = 1 := by simp
    -- Cast back to NNReal
    exact_mod_cast h₄

import Mathlib

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem algebra_amgm_sum1toneqn_prod1tonleq1
  (a : ℕ → NNReal)
  (n : ℕ)
  (h₀ : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x = n) :
  ∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x ≤ 1 := by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    simp at h₀ ⊢
    norm_num
  | succ n =>
    let k := n + 1
    -- Work in Reals
    have h_sum_real : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range k, (a x : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast h₀
    
    -- Apply geometric mean <= arithmetic mean
    -- Weights w i = 1
    have h_ineq : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range k, (a x : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (k : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
      have h_amgm : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range k, (a x : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (k : ℝ)) ≤ (∑ x ∈ Finset.range k, (a x : ℝ)) / (k : ℝ) := by
        -- Use Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean
        have h_w_pos : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range k, 0 ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by intro i hi; norm_num
        have h_w_sum_pos : 0 < ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 : ℝ) := by
          simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range]
          <;> norm_cast
          <;> linarith
        have h_f_nonneg : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range k, 0 ≤ (a i : ℝ) := by
          intro i hi
          exact NNReal.coe_nonneg (a i)
        
        -- The theorem statement:
        -- (∏ i ∈ s, f i ^ w i) ^ (∑ i ∈ s, w i)⁻¹ ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, w i * f i) / ∑ i ∈ s, w i
        -- With w i = 1, f i = a i
        -- (∏ a i ^ 1) ^ (k⁻¹) ≤ (∑ a i) / k
        -- Which is (∏ a i) ^ (1/k) ≤ (∑ a i) / k
        
        have h_geom : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (a i : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ)) ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 : ℝ) * (a i : ℝ)) / ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 : ℝ) := by
          apply Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean
          · intro i hi; norm_num
          · exact h_w_sum_pos
          · intro i hi; exact h_f_nonneg i hi
        
        -- Simplify the expressions to match the goal
        have h_lhs_eq : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (a i : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ)) ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 : ℝ))⁻¹ = (∏ x ∈ Finset.range k, (a x : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (k : ℝ)) := by
          simp [Finset.prod_const, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range]
          <;> field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> norm_num
          <;> simp_all [Finset.prod_const, Finset.sum_const]
          <;> field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> norm_num
        
        have h_rhs_eq : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 : ℝ) * (a i : ℝ)) / ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 : ℝ) = (∑ x ∈ Finset.range k, (a x : ℝ)) / (k : ℝ) := by
          simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range]
          <;> field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> norm_num
        
        rw [h_lhs_eq, h_rhs_eq] at h_geom
        exact h_geom
      
      have h_rhs_eq : (∑ x ∈ Finset.range k, (a x : ℝ)) / (k : ℝ) = 1 := by
        rw [h_sum_real]
        field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> norm_num
      
      rw [h_rhs_eq] at h_amgm
      exact h_amgm
    
    -- Deduce product <= 1
    have h_prod_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∏ x ∈ Finset.range k, (a x : ℝ) := by positivity
    
    have h_prod_le_one : ∏ x ∈ Finset.range k, (a x : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
      calc
        (∏ x ∈ Finset.range k, (a x : ℝ)) = (∏ x ∈ Finset.range k, (a x : ℝ)) ^ 1 := by simp
        _ = (∏ x ∈ Finset.range k, (a x : ℝ)) ^ ((1 / (k : ℝ)) * (k : ℝ)) := by

            norm_cast
            <;> linarith

          <;> ring_nf
          <;> norm_num

          <;> field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> norm_num
        _ ≤ 1 ^ (k : ℝ) := by gcongr
